minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  September 29, 2020
  The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
  on Tuesday, September 29, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority,
  Finance Authority, Parking Authority, Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:02 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Finance
  Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
  announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority/Finance Authority/ Parking Authority / Joint
  Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority, Parking Authority, Joint Powers Authority

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on
  the Agenda.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4 resident, spoke concerning the Warrant Register, and Agenda
  Item No., 3, approval of Amendment Three to Agreement No. 19-077 for the Welfare-to-
  Work Vocational, Intermediary and Direct Services by and between the County of Los
  Angeles and the City of Inglewood, serving as the administrative entity for the South Bay
  Workforce Investment Board (SBWIB).

  Bill (No last name given), spoke concerning Agenda Item Nos. 5, approval of
  Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 17-541 with County Hills Animal Clinic to
  continue providing veterinary services for the Police Department’s canines, and DR-5,
  adoption of a resolution to amend the Policies and Procedures Manual for the Inglewood
  COVID-19 Debit Card Program to increase the benefit amount from $500 to $1,000 per
  person.
219  JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY TREASURER – MONTHLY TREASURER’S
  REPORT. Staff report dated September 29, 2020, was presented submitting the Monthly
  Treasurer’s Report for the Month ending May 31, 2020.
  Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts ordered the report received and filed.

  1
 September 29, 2020

  JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Joint Powers Authority
  Member Franklin, and seconded by Joint Power Authority Member Padilla, that the
  Minutes for the Joint Powers Authority Meeting held on March 17, 2020, March 24,
  2020, and May 5, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Joint Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Joint
  Powers Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.98u

  There being no further business to be presented, Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:39 p.m.
  Approved this 4th day of May, 2021.
  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
